guidelines.raw: The only place a raw hex belongs. Everything else points here. Bright Blue 500 is the hero colour; the brand has no red — magenta carries caution.
guidelines.sem: What the specimens actually use. Repoint these to reshape the system; never hard-code a ramp step inside a layout.
guidelines.fam: Two families at most — display for headlines and buttons, body for everything else. Arial is the declared fallback.
guidelines.scale: Display and H1 set page rhythm; raising either re-flows every hero. Never below 24px on a slide or 12pt in print.
guidelines.space: A 4px grid. Section padding and gutter change page length and density everywhere at once — the small steps are safe local edits.
guidelines.radius: 20px is the signature radius: cards, image frames, swatches. Controls sit at 6–10px; chips are fully pill.
guidelines.shadow: Cool and Dark-Blue-tinted, never neutral grey. Cards lift 2px on hover; primary CTAs get a blue glow.
guidelines.motion: Short fades and settles, 120–320ms, ease-out. No bounce, no looping decoration.
guidelines.icon: Font Awesome, one weight per group, single colour. Concepts are tokens — change the token and every specimen follows.
guidelines.logo: The lockup is a token, not an image drop. Colour lockup on light, white on dark and photography, favicon for square crops.
guidelines.layout: These are the tokens that move layouts. Max width and gutter set the measure, head alignment flips every section header at once, module radius and shadow restyle every card in the system.
guidelines.photo: Foreground people stay full colour. A background photo must not contain people — a person over a crowd reads as two competing subjects; use the empty-floor shot and let the duotone make the setting unreadable. Never place a product card or headline over a face: anchor cut-outs bottom-right and cards bottom-left.
guidelines.graphic: One organic dot field in three baked colours. It never shows a hard edge — every dot image carries a radial mask, so its own rectangle can never appear; size it 1.25–1.5× its container and bleed it off two edges. Sit it low in the stack at 40–50% to connect people to product; never as a corner sticker.
guidelines.comp: Compositions are recipes, not one-offs: a treated background, a full-colour person, the dot field between them, and a product screen on top. Change the recipe here and every surface built on it re-stages — which arrangement, which screen, how strong the blue, how tall the person.
